intent: 日式动画背景感的中世纪城镇；暖墙、陶瓦、灰蓝点缀、清晰木石、成片林地。
provenance: Original art direction for ThreeHearths; SAO floor-one composition reference, no copied game assets.

rules.units: UE centimetres, source modelling metres; keep existing pivots, shared UVs and material slots
rules.construction: New geometry requires real proposal, ownership, materials, labour and persisted installation
rules.asset_iteration: Reuse the shared material library and modular dimensions; identify material slots semantically
rules.perception: NPC images are actual individual eye-position perspective captures; town maps are coordinator information
rules.style_is_not_fact: The charter constrains future appearance; no planned feature is asserted to exist
rules.landscape: Natural vegetation is an initial terrain art revision, not royal-funded planting or new harvest stock
